all_findings.issue: AC12 FAIL: .day-title CSS rule (font-size:14px; font-weight:600) is dead — no DOM element has class day-title. renderDaysPanel() assigns class 'day-row-label' to the primary day label span; .day-row-label is styled at 12px/600, not 14px/600. AC12 acceptance criterion requires computed .day-title font-size=14px, font-weight=600.
all_findings.recommendation: In renderDaysPanel(), change `label.className = 'day-row-label'` to `label.className = 'day-row-label day-title'`. This makes .day-title the applied rule (specificity tie broken by source order: .day-title declared after .day-row-label in CSS, wins font-size). Verify with Playwright: querySelector('.day-title') must be non-null, computed fontSize='14px'.

out_of_scope_observations.observation: AC5 spec-text vs implementation drift: AC5 literal text says '.pane-days and .pane-candidates have border: none'. The BA spec M9 technical hints section EXPLICITLY prescribes 'pane-days: border-right: 1px solid var(--border)' and 'pane-candidates: border-left: 1px solid var(--border)' as column separators. Implementation matches M9 technical hints, not AC5 literal text. Codex confirms these are real 1px borders. This is an intra-spec contradiction. The user need (no Bootstrap-era box-border panels, clean Notion visual separation) IS satisfied. Recommend BA updates AC5 literal text to align with M9: 'pane-days has no box-border (only border-right:1px as separator); pane-candidates has no box-border (only border-left:1px as separator)'.

Mobile AC5/AC6 potential drift: @media (max-width:639px) overrides pane-middle border-top to 4px (from 8px). AC5/AC6 are specified for desktop context ('1440x900 desktop primary') so this does not block the verdict. Codex flagged this as a secondary risk if tests run at 390px. Document as mobile exception in AC5/AC6 or remove the override.
